name: Late notification
description: Loss notified more than 30 days after the loss date

name: New or increased cover
description: Policy inception or increase in cover less than 60 days before the loss

name: Claim frequency
description: Two or more prior claims on the policy in 24 months

name: High amount for segment
description: Claimed amount above 1.5x the segment median

name: Non-network garage
description: Repairs at a garage outside Meridian's network

name: Night loss without police
description: Loss between 22:00 and 05:00 with no police report

name: Third-party representative
description: Public adjuster or lawyer involved at first notice

name: Interpreter required
description: Claimant correspondence flagged as requiring interpreter services

name: Risk area
description: Claimant postal area on the risk-area list (risk_areas_v3)

name: Document anomaly
description: Document resubmitted or file metadata edited after first upload

name: Shared contact details
description: Phone number linked to three or more claimants in 12 months

name: Total loss, older vehicle
description: Total-loss claim on a vehicle older than 12 years

name: Premium paid on loss date
description: Outstanding premium paid on the day of the loss

name: Review band
description: Score at or above which the claim shows an amber 'review' badge

name: Auto-referral
description: Score at or above which the claim is routed to the SIU queue and payment approval is held
